 Tip
Enrichment functions show supplemental information only when they're available.
Availability of information is varied and depends on many factors. Make sure to consider
this when using SeenBy() in your queries or in creating custom detections. For best results,
we recommend using the SeenBy() function with the DeviceInfo table.
